summary.text: Ravi Simon is the Democratic candidate for the Massachusetts House of Representatives, 13th Middlesex District, in the November 3, 2026 general election.

He is a member of the Lincoln-Sudbury Regional High School committee in Sudbury, with a term ending in 2029, and advanced from the September 1, 2026 Democratic primary; no Republican appeared on the primary ballot.

paragraphs.text: Ballotpedia lists endorsements of Simon from the Massachusetts AFL-CIO, the Massachusetts Teachers Association, Progressive Massachusetts, Reproductive Equity Now and the ELM Action Fund.
